evidence.claim: skillLevelMap is mapped by explicit local combat1/combat2/combat3 IDs; unknown IDs are unresolved and no Object.values ordering is used.
UID mapping contains display metadata, five artifact records, final fightProp stats, elemental detail stats, and persistent-stat provenance.
CalculationInput v2 retains characterId/level/constellation/talents/weapon/artifacts/stats plus source/importedAt/rawCharacterId and persistent-stat provenance flags.
The support projection derives artifact mode/counts, copies provider stats, retains a deep-cloned profileSnapshot, fixes support combatState, and initializes empty buffStates.

cloneProfileSnapshot preserves extra talent keys, all five artifact records, crit/ER/elemental detail stats, display metadata, and source provenance without sharing mutable references; sourceSnapshot and retainedFromUid distinguish the retained UID record from current form values.
Apply writes the form first, then dispatches genshin:calculation-input-selected with {input, profile}.
PartyState caches every UID CalculationInput by characterId and imports it when a support slot selects that character; the event listener is registered during init.

Imported support fields are written to the slot and marked UID; readSupportMember uses imported final/base stats, carries a deep-cloned profileSnapshot, and computes current member source independently from slot field origins.
Only enabled support slots feed talent/constellation/weapon/artifact candidates; provider calculations use member.stats, talentLevels, refinement, and artifact mode/IDs.
Main final-stat provenance is field-level UID/manual/mixed and always assumes persistent bonuses with externalModifiersOnly additive policy.
The calculation request is rebuilt from DOM values and party state; the selected CalculationInput object is not itself the calculation request.
Input provenance and profile mapper load before UID importer; DataContract, PartyState, PartyModifiers, and CalcEngine load before the user can apply a profile.

sequence: Apply writes main form values and precise UID stats
PartyState.registerUidProfile caches all mapped inputs by characterId
Selecting a support character imports the cached member into that slot
buildCalculationRequestFromForm rebuilds a CalculationRequest from DOM and normalized party state

selectionAndDeduplication.duplicateCharacters: main slot wins; then the first support slot wins; later duplicate slots become empty disabled members
selectionAndDeduplication.weaponType: UID weapon ID is accepted only when resolver weaponType equals selected character weaponType; incompatible selection is cleared/rejected

artifactModeSemantics.4pc: apply two-piece and first-set four-piece effects
artifactModeSemantics.2pc2pc: apply two-piece effects for both selected sets
artifactModeSemantics.2pc: apply one two-piece effect; never infer four-piece

finalStatsProvenance.uidStats: fightPropMap values are final profile values and include persistent bonuses
finalStatsProvenance.mainForm: genshinInputProvenance tracks each final-stat field as uid/manual and resolves uidProfile/manual/mixed
finalStatsProvenance.supportForm: slot field dataset.valueOrigin is used to resolve uidProfile/manual/mixed; PartyState handleChange marks non-import input/change events manual while retaining the original UID profileSnapshot
finalStatsProvenance.knownBoundary: The applyingImportedMember guard keeps imported writes as uid while normal slot input/change events become manual; provenance.sourceSnapshot and retainedFromUid identify the unchanged source snapshot and never rewrite it from manual values.

manualCombatBoundary.onField: support forced false; main forced true by normalizePartyState
manualCombatBoundary.hpRatio: support defaults to 100 and has no UID source or party UI control
manualCombatBoundary.buffStates: empty on import; only explicit condition toggles enable party effects
manualCombatBoundary.partyModifierUse: current collector consumes enabled, talent/constellation/refinement/artifact/provider-stat fields; it does not read combatState.onField or hpRatio.

talentOrderPolicy.rule: Local talent scalings explicitly map combat1/combat2/combat3 to normal/skill/burst. Unknown, partial, invalid, or conflicting IDs default all three provider levels to 1 and retain rawById; insertion order is never interpreted.

verification.result: focused bridge assertions and real Edge DOM import/edit/snapshot checks pass; talent order contract remains covered

openRisks: profileSnapshot is display/provenance-only and is not consumed as provider stats or automatic combat/buff state.
Current manually edited provider fields can diverge from the retained UID snapshot; provenance.source and sourceSnapshot must be read together.
Authoritative numeric UID skill IDs remain unresolved until a skillDepot/inherentProudSkill mapping fixture is available; raw levels are retained and safe level-1 provider values are used.
